newsitem.title: USA: Baker Hughes sees strong second half.
newsitem.headline: Baker Hughes sees strong second half.

text.p: Baker Hughes Inc said on Wednesday that it expects a strong second half as its oilfield companies implement plans for rapid internal growth.
At the same time, the company was "increasingly optimistic" about prospects for fiscal year 1998, said Max Lukens, president, chairman and chief executive officer of the compay.
The company continues to seek strategic acquisitions to increase our capacity in existing and related businesses, he added.
On other matters, the company said its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.115 per share of common stock payable May 23 to holders of record May 5.
The company issued the forecast as it reported record revenue and profit before tax for its second fiscal quarter ended March 31.
During the latest quarter, it said earnings rose 38 percent to $0.40 per share from $0.29 per share in the same period last year.

Profit before tax increased 32 percent to $92.9 million from $70.6 million in the year-ago quarter, on revenues of $833.2 million, which grew 12 percent from $744.8 million in last year's second quarter.
